observations: Two solar panels leaning against a wall.
The panels have dark cells and black frames.
There are white streaks or smudges on the glass surface of the front panel.
A watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
A small white sticker is visible on the top right corner of the left panel's frame, but the text is unreadable.
No specification plate or brand logo is visible on the front.

claims.evidence: The wattage is not visible on the panel; the specification label on the back is missing from the photos.
No brand name is legible in photo 0.
photo 0 shows panels with black cells and black frames.

risks.risk: The actual power output (wattage) may be significantly lower than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: Internal cell damage or micro-cracks not visible in a low-resolution photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass surface and a video showing a multimeter test of Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panels may be a different, less reputable brand than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the specification label showing the brand and model.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Close-up photos of the glass surface to check for cracks or delamination.
A video showing a multimeter reading of the panel's output in sunlight.
response.reason: The critical information for valuation—the rated wattage and brand—is contained on the specification plate on the back, which is not shown. Without this, the item cannot be distinguished from lower-capacity panels.
